label: Finding-46
title: waf-nine-hours: 'Hours before disclosure' is shown only for Cloudflare, and Fortinet's date is after disclosure
description: The lead clause applies to all five vendors, but only Cloudflare states a time before the release. Imperva says protection was verified and monitoring began 'before the announcement' with no time; Akamai and Fastly posts are dated 21 October with no time; Fortinet's FortiWeb article was created 10/22/2026 07:55 AM (timezone not stated) and its signatures are 'in Alert Only mode' by default. Suggested: 'Cloudflare from 03:02 UTC on 21 October; Imperva before the announcement; Akamai and Fastly on 21 October; Fortinet signatures by 22 October.'
